name: obsidian-second-brain
description: Turns an Obsidian vault into a persistent second brain for coding agents. Five skills enforce a project-bootstrap-first workflow, structured recall before non-trivial work, and structured capture of decisions/gotchas.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent, organized memory in your Obsidian vault for any coding agent.
interface.longDescription: Coding agents waste time and context every session rediscovering enterprise knowledge — architecture, APIs, process docs, prior decisions, recurring gotchas. This pack gives agents a structured vault, mandatory project bootstrap on entry, recall-before-coding, and structured capture of learnings. Filesystem-direct: no MCP, no server. Works across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini, and anything that reads markdown.
defaultPrompt: What does the vault know about <topic>?
